title: Local fibrations and homotopy-sheaf equivalences of simplicial presheaves
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $F,G:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{sSet}$ be presheaves of simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] and $f:F\to G$ a natural transformation. Products and restrictions are objectwise. Write $\Delta^n$ for the represented simplex, $\partial\Delta^n$ for its boundary, and $\Lambda_i^n$ for the union of faces other than $i$. Call $f$ a local Kan fibration if every square $\Lambda_i^n\to F(V)$, $\Delta^n\to G(V)$, for $n\ge1$, has a strict filler after restriction along each arrow in some covering sieve of $V$, with no compatibility required between these fillers.

For an objectwise Kan simplicial presheaf, let $\pi_n(F(V),x)$, $n\ge1$, be pointed simplices $(\Delta^n,\partial\Delta^n)\to(F(V),x)$ modulo relative cylinder homotopy (the equivalence relation generated by such homotopies). Maps are postcomposition. This is the underlying set of the usual homotopy group. Call $f$ a local weak equivalence if its $\pi_0$ presheaf map becomes an isomorphism under sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] and the following local bijectivity conditions hold for every $V$, $x\in F(V)_0$, and $n\ge1$: every class in $\pi_n(G(V),f(x))$ lifts to $\pi_n(F(W),x|_W)$ along each arrow $W\to V$ in some covering sieve, and two classes in $\pi_n(F(V),x)$ with equal images become equal after restriction along every arrow in some covering sieve. The target basepoints are identified by the naturality equality $f(x|_W)=f(x)|_W$. These conditions are equivalently isomorphisms on the associated homotopy sheaves on every slice $\mathcal C/V$, with its induced topology.
